title: Contrastive Knowledge Distillation for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Illumination/Focus Display Images
abstract: arXiv:2609.05520v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we tackle automatic anomaly detection in multi-illumination and multi-focus display images. The minute defects on the display surface are hard to spot out in RGB images and by a model trained with only normal data. To address this, we propose a novel contrastive learning scheme for knowledge distillation-based anomaly detection. In our framework, Multiresolution Knowledge Distillation (MKD) is adopted as a baseline, which operates by measuring feature similarities between the teacher and student networks. Based on MKD, we propose a novel contrastive learning method, namely Multiresolution Contrastive Distillation (MCD), which does not require positive/negative pairs with an anchor but operates by pulling/pushing the distance between the teacher and student features. translated_title: 多光照/多焦点显示图像异常检测的对比知识蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究多光照和多焦点显示图像中的自动异常检测问题。显示表面的微小缺陷在RGB图像中很难被发现，仅用正常数据训练的模型也难以将其检测出来。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的对比学习方案，用于基于知识蒸馏的异常检测。在我们的框架中，采用多分辨率知识蒸馏作为基线，该方法通过测量教师网络和学生网络之间的特征相似度来工作。基于MKD，我们提出了一种新颖的对比学习方法，即多分辨率对比蒸馏，它不需要带有锚点的正/负样本对，而是通过拉近/推远教师和学生特征之间的距离来进行学习。此外，我们还提出了一个融合模块，用于将多通道信息转换并聚合到MCD的三通道输入层。
tldr: 本文提出多分辨率对比蒸馏（MCD）方法，无需正负样本对，通过拉近/推远师生网络特征距离，实现多光照/多焦点显示图像中微小缺陷的异常检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Multiresolution Contrastive Distillation (MCD), a novel contrastive learning method that enables anomaly detection of minute defects in multi-illumination/focus display images by pulling/pushing the distance between teacher and student features without requiring positive/negative pairs.
